value.title: Docs in the pij CLI: one source, checked
value.summary: PRD 009 workstream step s02 (req-04). A `harness checks` stage, `just docs-bundle-check`, asks the checkout's built pij-rs for every page it bundles and compares each with its file; a page that differs, a page file not bundled, or a bundled page with no file fails the stage by name.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Plan 235 compiles each page in with `include_str!`, so a page is its file at build time. Between builds they drift: an edited page reads the old text until pij-rs is rebuilt. The stage reads what the binary actually prints, so `harness checks --quick` (which skips the Rust build) fails on an edited page until it is rebuilt, and a full `harness checks` passes only once the binary it built carries the edit. `pij docs list --json` names each page's source file, so the check restates no table.

sections.name: goals
value: A page that differs from its file cannot pass `harness checks`.
The check reads the producer: what pij-rs prints and which file it names, never a second list.

sections.name: non_goals
value: Checking the pij-rs installed on PATH: a branch that edits a page would fail against the installed main build until it merged and installed. Open question q-1.

value.claim: `pij docs list --json` gives each page's `source`, its path from the repository root.

`just docs-bundle-check` runs the checkout's built pij-rs (`<cargo target>/debug/pij-rs` from `harness/scripts/cargo-target.sh`, or `PIJ_RS_BIN`), lists its pages, gets each with `--json` and compares `text` with its source file byte for byte. It fails, naming each, on a page that differs, a `docs/cli/**/*.md` file that is not bundled, and a bundled page whose source is missing. With no built binary it exits non-zero with the build command, never a silent pass.
The stage is in `.harness/extensions/checks/` after the Rust gate and in `just self-check` after `just rust-check`, so a full run checks the binary it just built.

value.title: Bundled pages checked
value.brief: One PR (#348): the source field, the check script and its test, the stage.

sections.name: research_context
sections.value: Sensors live in `.harness/extensions/checks/extension.ts` (SENSORS) and `just self-check`, added together (AGENTS.md). Plan 235's `docs.rs` table already holds every `docs/cli` file listed at `cargo test` time, but that test rebuilds the binary first, so it cannot see drift between a build and an edit; this stage can. When the type pages come from the daemon's type catalog (blueprint 005 c-type-catalog), their source is that catalog's file and the same comparison applies.

value.risk: A stale debug binary from another worktree's build fails this tree's check.
value.mitigation: The failure names the page and the rebuild command; shared-build already rebuilds this tree's crates when another tree built there (F243).

value.question: Should `just doctor` also warn when the pij-rs on PATH bundles a page that differs from main's file?
value.default: No: the installed binary matches its own version by construction (req-03); doctor already says when pij-rs is behind.

sections.name: execution_guardrails
value: Cost: no loop, poll, timer or hook. On demand only, inside `harness checks`: one `pij-rs docs list` and one `pij-rs docs get` per bundled page (a handful today), absolute-path launches of the built binary; no daemon contact. Scales with pages, not seats.
